title: Quicksilver Sash — Overview
text: Quicksilver Sash, commonly called QSS, is an epic League of Legends item. It grants 30 magic resistance. Its Quicksilver active removes crowd-control debuffs from the user's champion, except airborne effects, and has a 90-second cooldown. A champion is limited to one Quicksilver item.

title: Quicksilver Sash — Cost and Recipe
text: Quicksilver Sash costs 1300 gold and sells for 910 gold. Its recipe consists of Null-Magic Mantle plus a 900-gold combine cost. It builds into Mercurial Scimitar.

title: Quicksilver Sash — Cleanse Interactions
text: Quicksilver Sash removes crowd-control effects including suppression and nearsight, but it cannot remove airborne effects or stasis. Unlike the Cleanse summoner spell, it does not grant tenacity and does not remove summoner-spell debuffs. Quicksilver Sash cannot be activated while the champion is airborne.

title: Quicksilver Sash — Availability
text: Quicksilver Sash is available on Summoner's Rift, Howling Abyss ARAM, and Nexus Blitz. It is categorized for fighters, marksmen, assassins, and magic-resistance builds.

title: Quicksilver Sash — Patch 14.15
text: In patch 14.15, the combine cost of Quicksilver Sash increased from 850 gold to 900 gold. Its total cost remained unchanged.

title: Quicksilver Sash — Patch 14.8
text: In patch 14.8, No longer cleanses Mordekaiser's ability Realm of Death.
